addr: HSR Layout, Sector 1, Beside Agara Fly Over Service Road Near Govt. Civil Hospital, behind Jagannatha Temple, Sarjapur road, Outer Ring Road, Hosur road, 560035, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: Good place to take your toddler or kid for some playtime and physical activities. The place has separate sections for kids up to 3 years and kids above 3 years. That way the play area becomes safe for small kids. They charge Rs.350 per hour …

Attended a birthday party for a friend’s son — great setup for around 30 guests.
•	Kids had a blast in the age-based play zones (safe & well-managed). …
The best indoor play area at HSR  for kids and toddlers. Kids can have great time with different activities and toys available. Separate play zones available as per the age group of kids.
